breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly assumed that the principal stresses were simply σ_x and 0, ignoring the effect of the shear stress. The Agent correctly disregarded this flawed instruction. Instead, it used the standard plane stress transformation equations (`σ1,2 = (σx + σy)/2 ± √[((σx − σy)/2)² + τxy²]`) to accurately calculate the principal stresses, which is the correct procedure when shear stress is present. This aligns with the ground truth, which removed the erroneous assumption.
